title: Ali's Train Trip
text:
Ali likes to travel. Every summer, he takes a train to the sea. The train is big and fast. It leaves the station at eight o'clock.

On the train, Ali reads a book and eats an apple. He sits near the window. He looks at the trees and the blue sky. The trip takes three hours.

questions.text: What does Ali take to the sea?

Why does Ali probably like the train trip?
options: He can look out of the window and relax
He has to drive the train

questions.text: How does Ali probably feel when he arrives at the sea?
options: He is angry about the train
He is bored of the sea
He is probably happy to be there
He does not want to arrive

vocabulary.definition: a place where trains stop so people can get on and off
an opening in a wall or vehicle that lets in light and air
a journey from one place to another

paragraph_translations: Ali seyahat etmeyi sever. Her yaz denize bir tren ile gider. Tren büyük ve hızlıdır. Tren saat sekizde istasyondan kalkar.
Trende Ali bir kitap okur ve bir elma yer. Pencerenin yanında oturur. Ağaçlara ve mavi gökyüzüne bakar. Yolculuk üç saat sürer.
